note: Cameras permanently excluded from the shipped fixture, applied by scripts/export-mobile-assets.mjs. A camera listed here is dropped from mobile/src/data/bands.json and can never be re-added by an export -- not by --source fixture, not by --only, not from state.json or learned-bands.json. Removing a row is the only way back, and it should be done only with a fresh overlay proving the camera holds the view its geometry was learned on. The band-loss guard deliberately ignores these ids: disabling one is an intended loss, not the accident the guard exists to catch. Of 208 City cameras the app covers a hand-picked few, so a camera that cannot be trusted is cheap to drop and expensive to keep.

162.why: PTZ: the camera no longer holds the view its band was learned on.
162.evidence: Corner direction label read E on the learning-era frame (data/debug-162.jpg) and W live. The shipped band drawn on a current frame crosses the roadway and the crosswalk instead of lying on a curb. Re-learning from data/history/162.jsonl (303 rows) yields ZERO bands, which is what a view change looks like to the learner.
